data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (DEALS, Deals & Promotions, open the region selector, pick a region) and correctly parameterizes region, but it adds an "Open amtrak.com" step and calls the selector 'Display deals in' instead of 'All Regions', which could make the selector click ambiguous.
